entities.name: Nicolae Crețulescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolae Kretzulescu was a Wallachian, later Romanian politician and physician. An aristocrat and member of the Kretzulescu family, he served two terms as Prime Minister of Romania: from 1862 to 1863, and from 1865 to 1866. He was also elected to the Romanian Academy, serving as its 3rd president from 1872 to 1873.
